largeheadline.line1: The power to do more.
largeheadline.line2: The T2 Alpha Femur Retrograde nail is an intramedullary nail for the treatment of distal and diaphyseal femur fractures. It is the result of over 20 years of continuous innovation and clinical history.

text_copy.text:
Advanced nail design
 

Updated Locking Configuration

Added proximal and distal locking options, three planes of fixation, and the most distal screw 6mm from the driving end of the nail allows for adequate stability and fixation.1,5

Improved anatomic fit 

Length dependent radius of curvature (.70-1.35m)2,3 and variable distal posterior bend designed for an improved anatomic fit. This may allow for both a standard entry and more posterior start point in periprosthetic fractures*. 2,3,6

Putting more options in your hands

Hybrid locking configuration designed for fixation of distal and diaphyseal femur fractures.1 Additional indications for fractures involving osteopenic and osteoporotic bone, as well as periprosthetic fractures**.

text.text:
Stability when and where you need it


Advanced Locking Screws

Provide increased axial fracture stability in any 5mm round locking hole when the surgeon chooses.1,2

IMN Locking Screws

IMN locking screw design provides increased fatigue strength compared to competition.2

Femur Condyle Screws

Adjustable condyle screws allow for a range of 2mm longer or 5mm shorter than the actual condyle screw length for compression of femur condyle fragments.

Instrumentation made easy

Streamlined instrumentation platform

One core basic tray that is used for Gamma4 and T2 Alpha antegrade femur, retrograde femur and tibia designed to improve platform consistency and ease of use.1

Guided proximal targeting devices for short and long nails

Designed to provide reproducible locking, and reduce the total number of x-ray shots compared to freehand locking.4,7,8

Static targeting arm

Designed to provide stability and procedural ease during distal screw insertion.1

rte.text:
The innovation you expect meets a design you’ve never experienced.

Our customers needed intraoperative adaptability and security in an intramedullary nailing solution , and that’s what our system provides. Created with a redefined nail design to treat varying patient needs, advanced locking screws for increased stability, and innovative instrumentation, the T2 Alpha Femur retrograde intramedullary nailing system delivers a new level of innovation.

  • Data driven SOMA designed hybrid nails for diverse anatomical patient needs. 1,2
  • Added locking options for intraoperative adaptability.1,2
  • Advanced Locking screws are designed to limit relative motion between the nail and the screw.3 
  • Guided targeting designed to provide more reproducible locking and reduce the total number of x-ray shots compared to freehand locking. 4,7,8
